title: Validity of lien.
officialText:
In any proceeding to enforce or discharge a lien created pursuant to section 28-204.6, the validity of the lien shall not be subject to challenge based on the lawfulness of the judgment, except as provided in section 28-204.6.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
